recipe.visualDefinition: A central large, slightly tilted five-pointed star containing a full-body portrait of a performer, surrounded by bold, arched, and layered typography in a mix of Western slab and decorative styles, set against a clean white background with scattered small star accents.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure is layered behind the primary title text but in front of the star background.
The star acts as a frame for the subject while anchoring the diagonal typographic flow.
Small blue stars provide a secondary visual texture that balances the heavy central mass.
coreInvariants: A large, multi-layered five-pointed star with a yellow offset shadow.
A central human figure in a high-contrast pose.
Arched typography following the contours of the star's points.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered vertically within the star, scaled to fit from the top point to the bottom legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue star with a yellow drop-shadow serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left name, follows the arch down to the large central word, and rests on the bottom title segment.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High amount of white negative space surrounding the central star cluster to emphasize the graphic shape.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple-blue for the main star and primary text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow used as a hard-edged offset shadow for the star.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light sky blue for the secondary large text and small decorative stars.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary shapes contrasted against a stark white background and a photographic subject in neutral tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Western Slab Serif and Decorative Display
letterConstructionRules: Heavy horizontal serifs with curved, bracketed transitions.
Internal decorative cutouts or 'spurs' on vertical strokes.
Arched baselines that follow the radial symmetry of the star.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features exaggerated curls and a heavy middle bar.
The 'O' is a tall, narrow oval with thick vertical walls.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mixing different weights and colors of the same decorative slab family to create depth.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Western slab serif aesthetic with heavy horizontal emphasis.
Provides the decorative spurs and mid-century show-poster feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a large, slightly tilted purple five-pointed star with a yellow offset shadow on a white background. Place a full-body photo of a man in a 1960s white suit inside the star. Scatter small light-blue stars around the main star.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three layers of text: a top name arched upwards in dark brown, a central large word in sky blue with a dark blue outline, and a bottom word in yellow arched downwards. Use a heavy Western slab serif font for all.

verificationChecks: Is the star tilted approximately 15 degrees?
Does the central text overlap the subject's torso?
Are the small stars scattered randomly but balanced?
Is the yellow shadow on the star hard-edged?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text follows the star's geometry.
Check that the subject feels integrated into the star frame.
Verify the high-contrast 'pop' of the yellow shadow.
Confirm the white background remains clean and uncluttered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Star Frame + Layered Subject + Arched Western Typography + Offset Shadow + White Space
